manage.scopeHint: Approved Dify endpoints and synthetic test data only.

manage.connected: Connected. The app parameters meet pilot requirements.
manage.appIdHint: Copy the app ID from its Dify page URL.

manage.name: Agent name
manage.reviewPlaceholder: Describe the purpose, synthetic input scope and definition verification.
manage.approveHint: Confirm the definition matches the published Dify version and verify allowed users. Publishing enables their access.
manage.disableHint: Disabling blocks new tasks. Remote tasks already sent are not automatically cancelled.
manage.editHint: Saving changes revokes publication and requires another review.
manage.rotationHint: After validating the new key, the agent is disabled and its credential replaced. Review and publish it again when complete.

manage.draftCreated: Configuration saved. Review and publish it to allow use.
manage.failed: Operation failed. Try again or contact an administrator.
